title: WORLD ACCEPTANCE CORP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: World Acceptance Corporation filed an 8-K disclosing the resignation of President and CEO R. Chad Prashad effective April 10, 2026, to pursue other opportunities. The company entered a separation agreement granting Prashad $1,260,000 severance over 24 months, accelerated vesting of equity awards, and 18 months of COBRA coverage. The Board appointed Janet L. Matricciani as Interim President and CEO effective April 13, 2026.
key_points: R. Chad Prashad resigned as President, CEO, and Board member effective April 10, 2026
Resignation characterized as termination without cause under employment agreement terms
Separation agreement includes $1,260,000 severance payable over 24 months
Accelerated vesting granted for time-based stock options and equity incentive awards
Janet L. Matricciani appointed Interim President and CEO effective April 13, 2026
Matricciani's base salary under employment agreement: $83,333 per month
